reflection_rate.label: Reflection Rate
reflection_rate.help: Reviews reflected / reviews submitted. Are submitted reviews actually going live?

order_submission_rate.label: Order Submission %
order_submission_rate.help: Reviews submitted / net orders. Above 100% means more submissions than net orders, so check for double counting.

cancellation_rate.label: Cancellation / Not-Delivered %
cancellation_rate.help: Orders not marked 'Shipped - Delivered to Buyer', over total orders. This is the sheet's own Cancellation% definition.

true_cancel_rate.label: True Cancelled %
true_cancel_rate.help: Only rows whose Amazon status is exactly 'Cancelled'.

return_rate.label: Return Rate
return_rate.help: Orders with a return status, over total orders.

delivery_rate.label: Delivery Rate
delivery_rate.help: Orders delivered to buyer, over total orders.

seller_feedback_rate.label: Seller Feedback Rate
seller_feedback_rate.help: Seller feedback given, over reviews submitted.

checker_verified_rate.label: Checker Verified %
checker_verified_rate.help: Rows signed off by the checker, over reviews submitted. Low means a verification backlog.

payment_done_rate.label: Payment Completion %
payment_done_rate.help: Orders with payment marked Paid or Settled, over total orders.

payment_pending_amt.label: Payment Pending
payment_pending_amt.help: Order value we still owe: payment neither Paid nor Cancelled.

paid_unreflected_amt.label: Paid but Review Not Reflected
paid_unreflected_amt.help: Money already paid out where the review has not reflected. This is the main recovery exposure.

paid_undelivered_amt.label: Paid but Not Delivered
paid_undelivered_amt.help: Money paid on orders that were cancelled or returned.

unreconciled_amt.label: Unreconciled with Amazon
unreconciled_amt.help: Order value of rows with no Amazon Price captured.

exception_rate.label: Rows with Exceptions %
exception_rate.help: Share of orders tripping at least one audit rule.

target_achievement.label: Target Achievement %
target_achievement.help: Actual orders vs the Monthly Targets Report, per product.

missing_mandatory.label: Mandatory field blank
missing_mandatory.help: Order ID, ASIN, intern name or order date is empty.

duplicate_order_id.label: Duplicate Order ID
duplicate_order_id.help: The same Amazon order ID appears on more than one row.

future_order_date.label: Order date in the future
future_order_date.help: Order date is later than today.

order_price_range.label: Order price outside expected range
order_price_range.help: Order price below the minimum or above the maximum. Catches typos and stray decimals.

status_blank.label: Amazon status blank
status_blank.help: No Amazon status this many days after the order date.

stuck_in_transit.label: Stuck in transit
stuck_in_transit.help: Still Shipped / Pending / Out for Delivery this many days after ordering.

review_link_sla.label: Review not submitted within SLA
review_link_sla.help: Order delivered but no review link this many days after the order date.

reflect_sla.label: Review submitted but not reflected within SLA
reflect_sla.help: Review link present but reflection still false after this many days.

reflected_without_link.label: Marked reflected without a review link
reflected_without_link.help: Reflection is TRUE but there is no review link, so it cannot be verified.

checker_pending.label: Checker sign-off pending
checker_pending.help: Review submitted this many days ago and the checker has still not verified it.

seller_feedback_missing.label: Seller feedback missing on a reflected order
seller_feedback_missing.help: Review reflected but no seller feedback recorded.

payment_pending_age.label: Payment pending too long
payment_pending_age.help: Payment still not Paid or Settled this many days after the order date.

payment_unknown.label: Payment status unrecognised or on hold
payment_unknown.help: Payment text does not resolve to Paid, Pending or Cancelled.

paid_not_reflected.label: Paid but review not reflected
paid_not_reflected.help: Money paid out this many days ago and the review still has not reflected.

paid_not_delivered.label: Paid but order not delivered
paid_not_delivered.help: Payment marked Paid on an order that was cancelled or returned.

amazon_price_missing.label: Amazon price not captured
amazon_price_missing.help: Delivered order with no Amazon price this many days after ordering.

amazon_price_gap.label: Order vs Amazon price mismatch
amazon_price_gap.help: Absolute difference between order price and Amazon price exceeds the tolerance.

return_no_signoff.label: Return without checker sign-off
return_no_signoff.help: Return status recorded but the return checker column is not OK.

return_no_pickup.label: Return with no pickup partner
return_no_pickup.help: Return status recorded but 'Return Pickup By' is blank.

unknown_intern.label: Intern not on the roster
unknown_intern.help: Intern name in MAIN has no match in the Intern Report Manual roster.

order_outside_tenure.label: Order outside the intern tenure
order_outside_tenure.help: Order date falls before joining or after leaving, beyond the grace period.

not_in_amazon_report.label: Order ID missing from the Amazon report
not_in_amazon_report.help: Order ID in MAIN has no match in 'Amazon Order Report Pasting'.
